text: Silver plan covers in-patient hospitalisation up to INR 5 lakh per policy year. Room rent is capped at 1 percent of the sum insured per day.
Pre-existing diseases are covered under the Silver plan only after a waiting period of 36 months of continuous coverage.
Gold plan covers in-patient hospitalisation up to INR 10 lakh per policy year with no room rent cap, and includes day-care procedures.
Cosmetic or aesthetic treatment and plastic surgery are excluded under the Gold plan unless needed to treat an injury from an accident.
Pre-existing diseases are covered under the Gold plan after a waiting period of 24 months of continuous coverage.
Platinum plan covers in-patient hospitalisation up to INR 25 lakh per policy year, with no room rent cap and an international second medical opinion.
Motor Gold plan includes zero depreciation cover on replaced parts and 24x7 roadside assistance.
A policy can be renewed within a 30 day grace period after expiry. Claims for events that happen during the grace period are not payable.
